CONFOUNDERS: Multiple significant issues - severely underpowered (N=4), terminated early due to withdrawn sponsor support (commercial decision), and high toxicity burden (50% grade ≥3 AEs, multiple serious immune-related AEs). The combination of commercial termination and insufficient enrollment makes this a failed trial with multiple contributing factors.
